name: gh
description: File GitHub issues a maintainer can still act on in three years — evidence and reproduction before prose, duplicates and the repo's own templates checked first, every symbol backticked and every source link pinned to a tag or a commit, long output folded into details blocks, local paths and PII stripped before anything is opened — plus the rendered-markdown writing discipline those bodies follow, reusable for any pull request, comment, or ticket a renderer will show a human
